# Requests and routes

> the doctor's request for one patient, and the route its samples take to each lab

**Types:** `Request`, `Route`, `RouteTask`, `RouteHandling`, `Link`, `TubeRow`, `Instruction` (package Requests)

**Commands in:** Collected, Create, DeviationPending, DeviationResolved, Expect, Haemolysed, Instruct, Link, Missing, Plan, Rejected, Released, SampleStopped

**Events out:** RequestCompleted, RequestCreated, RequestFailed, RoutePlanned, SampleStopped

**Policies reacting:** register_samples (on RequestCreated); open_patient_view (on RequestCreated); report_stop (on SampleStopped); patient_ready (on RequestCompleted); patient_redraw (on RequestFailed)

## Rules

<a id="R4"></a>
### R4 — A request is for one patient, with a route per lab

`agreed` · definitional · decided in session 1, 2026-03-02

A request is for one patient. It has one route per lab its samples go to; a sample referred on to a reference lab is on that lab's route.

- **Model:** `package Requests`, `Request`, `Route`
- **Shown by:** 01-two-tubes-to-the-lab, 06-referred-to-the-reference-lab

<a id="R5"></a>
### R5 — A request ends when its routes have

`agreed` · behavioural · decided in session 1, 2026-03-02

When every route has ended, the request is completed if all were, partially completed if any route completed or partly completed, and failed otherwise.

- **Model:** `Request.open on_children routes.all_final#completed`, `Request.open on_children routes.all_final#partial`, `Request.open on_children routes.all_final`
- **Shown by:** 01-two-tubes-to-the-lab, 02-haemolysed-at-the-lab, 05-one-of-two-haemolysed

<a id="R6"></a>
### R6 — A sample stopped anywhere on the route was not reported

`agreed` · behavioural · decided in session 1, 2026-03-02

A sample that stops anywhere on its route — haemolysed, missing, rejected, too old — fails the route's report for it. One that stops before it is collected does not count either way.

- **Model:** `RouteHandling.open on SampleStopped`
- **Shown by:** 02-haemolysed-at-the-lab
